title: EZInput: A Cross-Environment Python Library for Easy UI Generation in Scientific Computing
abstract: arXiv:2601.08859v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Researchers face a persistent barrier when applying computational algorithms with parameter configuration typically demanding programming skills, interfaces differing across environments, and settings rarely persisting between sessions. This fragmentation forces repetitive input, slows iterative exploration, and undermines reproducibility because parameter choices are difficult to record, share, and reuse. We present EZInput, a cross-runtime environment Python library enabling algorithm developers to automatically generate graphical user interfaces that make their computational tools accessible to end-users without programming expertise. EZInput employs a declarative specification system where developers define input requirements and validation constraints once; the library then handles environment detection, interface rendering, parameter validation, and session persistence across Jupyter notebooks, Google Colab, and terminal enviro

translated_title: EZInput：一个用于科学计算中便捷生成用户界面的跨环境Python库
translated_abstract: 研究人员在应用计算算法时面临一个持续存在的障碍：参数配置通常需要编程技能，不同环境间接口存在差异，且设置很少能在会话之间持久保存。这种碎片化问题迫使用户重复输入，减缓了迭代探索的速度，并损害了可重复性，因为参数选择难以记录、共享和复用。我们提出了EZInput，一个跨运行时环境的Python库，使算法开发人员能够自动生成图形用户界面，让不具备编程专业知识的最终用户也能使用他们的计算工具。EZInput采用声明式规范系统，开发人员只需定义一次输入需求和验证约束；该库即可处理环境检测、界面渲染、参数验证和会话持久化，涵盖Jupyter笔记本、Google Colab和终端环境。
tldr: EZInput是一个跨环境Python库，通过声明式规范系统自动生成图形用户界面，让无编程经验的用户也能便捷配置科学计算工具的参数，并实现会话持久化以提升可重复性。
